title: PHANTOM Cyber-Physical Digital Twin Architecture
full_script: PHANTOM GRID presents the In-Memory Cyber-Physical Digital Twin State Engine. Synchronizing motor RPM, degradation flags, battery millivolts, and thermal gradients at sub-millisecond speeds. Triple-channel cyber-physical mapping powers autonomous HPC controllers, cockpit HUD telltales, and cloud V2X fleets. Certified with 100% Honors Pass resilience, zero commercial token cost, fully open source.
